description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Notification" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered to service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairDone" name="Repair done, Pickerl issued"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService" name="Car Service">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police App" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CarOwner" name="Car Owner" processRef="Process_CarOwner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Notify" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="StartEvent_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="StartEvent_CarDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdate" name="Status update" sourceRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Catch_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairDone" name="Repair done" sourceRef="SendTask_RepairDone" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed" sourceRef="SendTask_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police App" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_NextServiceDue" name="Next service due">
      <bpmn:documentation>Waits until the next service date entered by the mechanic.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_NextServiceDue"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check car registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner" messageRef="Msg_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_30Days" name="30 days passed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitCheck" name="Car brought to service?" default="Flow_NotBrought"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisitConfirmed" name="Service visit confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered, no notification"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="Timer_NextServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P2" sourceRef="Timer_NextServiceDue" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Timer_30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P5" sourceRef="Timer_30Days" targetRef="Gateway_VisitCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brought" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitCheck" targetRef="End_VisitConfirmed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carBroughtToService}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotBrought" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitCheck" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P6" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarOwner" name="Car Owner" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Notification" name="Service reminder received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Notification" messageRef="Msg_Notification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BringCar" name="Bring car"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm car delivery" messageRef="Msg_CarDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_StatusUpdate" name="Status update received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_StatusUpdate" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairDone" name="Repair done received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairDone" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayRepair" name="Pay repair"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Repair paid"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_O1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Notification" targetRef="Task_BringCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_O2" sourceRef="Task_BringCar" targetRef="SendTask_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_O3" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Catch_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_O4" sourceRef="Catch_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_O5" sourceRef="Catch_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_PayRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_O6" sourceRef="Task_PayRepair" targetRef="End_Paid"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarDeliveredFacility" messageRef="Msg_CarDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordProblems" name="Enter car problems"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_StatusUpdate" name="Send status update" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Repair" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordRepair" name="Enter successful repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RepairDone" name="Send repair done" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NextService" name="Enter next service time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ServiceCompleted" name="Send service completed" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CarDelivered" targetRef="Task_RecordProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="Task_RecordProblems" targetRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Task_RecordRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Task_RecordRepair" targetRef="SendTask_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="SendTask_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_NextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="Task_NextService" targetRef="SendTask_ServiceCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="SendTask_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="End_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
